description: This PHP source file defines the ActivityDetailsReportController class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It is responsible for preparing Vue.js components with relevant data based on HTTP request query parameters such as date ranges, project, activity, and timesheet inclusion status.

classes.name: ActivityDetailsReportController
classes.description: A controller class that prepares the Vue component with properties based on request parameters for displaying activity details and reports in the HRM system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue.js component by adding properties such as date range, project info, activity info, and timesheet inclusion status, based on the HTTP request query parameters.
